headline: HEG Demerger to Take Effect from September 1, 2026; Record Date Fixed for September 7, 2026
sum: HEG Limited announces demerger scheme effective September 1, 2026, with record date set for September 7, 2026, and concurrent leadership changes. Press release filed with NSE formally notifying shareholders and the market of the scheme becoming operative.
implication: Demerger effective date (Sep 1) preceded by a one-week lag to record date (Sep 7) creates operational window for share registry closure and allotment mechanics-typical for Indian demergers but requires careful coordination with depository and share transfer agent on Ex-date posting and credit timelines.
detail: HEG Limited, a Hinduja Group flagship in graphite electrodes and carbon products (listed on NSE and BSE), has publicly announced its demerger scheme with effect from September 1, 2026. The record date for determining entitlements under the scheme is fixed for September 7, 2026. Concurrent with the scheme's operationalization, the company has also announced changes in leadership structure. This is a material corporate action requiring coordinated disclosure across both stock exchanges and triggering shareholder communication, depository protocols, and potential regulatory confirmations.
